irrigation.missingReport: Irrigation advice needs an active soil report.

normal: Maintain moderate irrigation and avoid standing water.
Monitor field moisture before each cycle.
medium: Use shorter irrigation cycles to prevent nutrient washout.
Add mulch around root zone to preserve moisture.
high: Increase irrigation frequency with lower volume per cycle.
Prioritize drip or furrow method for efficient water use.
